summary: Phase 3 Voice Notes testing completed. FIXED 2 CRITICAL bugs: (1) ChatPage.jsx missing state variables (showStoryViewer, selectedStoryGroup, viewersStoryId) - caused runtime error breaking entire chat page, (2) chat.py WebSocket used db.chat_messages but GET API used db.messages - messages were saved to wrong collection causing message disappearing issue (user's reported bug). All 11 backend tests pass. Voice Notes UI fully functional.

fixed.issue: Data collection mismatch - WebSocket saved to db.chat_messages but GET /api/chat/messages read from db.messages. Messages appeared momentarily then disappeared after page reload.
fixed.fix: Changed all db.chat_messages references to db.messages (lines 562, 597, 603, 615, 621)

fixed.issue: Missing state variable declarations: showStoryViewer, selectedStoryGroup, viewersStoryId were used but never declared with useState. Caused 'showStoryViewer is not defined' runtime error that crashed the entire Chat page.
fixed.fix: Added missing useState declarations after line 66

critical_code_review_comments: The db.chat_messages vs db.messages mismatch was likely introduced during a refactor - always ensure collection names are consistent across HTTP and WebSocket handlers

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Chat page loads, Voice Notes modal works, message sending/receiving works

seed_data_creation: Messages created during testing in messages collection
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Voice Notes feature is working. Chat page loads correctly, Voice Recorder modal opens on mic button click with waveform visualization and timer. Message sending and receiving now works correctly - the db collection mismatch bug has been fixed. Voice upload endpoint requires actual audio files with proper MIME types for full testing (browser microphone needed).

issue_1.symptom: Chat page crashed with 'showStoryViewer is not defined' error
issue_1.root_cause: State variables (showStoryViewer, selectedStoryGroup, viewersStoryId) were used in JSX at lines 829-846 but never declared with useState
issue_1.fix: Added missing useState declarations after line 66 in ChatPage.jsx

issue_2.symptom: Messages appeared momentarily then disappeared - user reported 'message receiving not working'
issue_2.root_cause: Data collection mismatch: WebSocket handler wrote to db.chat_messages (line 562) but GET /messages endpoint read from db.messages (line 411)
issue_2.fix: Changed all WebSocket operations to use db.messages collection consistently
